description: The reference's Large Diesel preset: a 14.9 L inline six, twin turbos: a heavy truck's engine.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: The governor holds
targets.source: a diesel's governor holds the speed at its high idle within a few percent

targets.name: Warm idle
targets.source: a heavy-duty diesel idles at 600 to 800 rpm (a rule of thumb from makers' specifications)

targets.name: Governed speed
targets.source: a heavy truck diesel's rated speed is about 1700 to 2100 rpm and its governed no-load speed some 10 to 15 % above: 1800 to 2400 rpm (a rule of thumb)

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a turbocharged heavy-duty diesel's bmep at its torque peak is 1.8 to 2.4 MPa (Heywood, ch. 2; makers' data for 13 to 16 L sixes): T = bmep Vd / 4 pi for 14.9 L
